metadata.title: HookLens demo — 90-second path & Demo Lock
metadata.description: How to run the Reddit Twin demo safely: scripted path, Demo Lock checklist, and backup recording before any public show.

hero.title: 90 seconds to oh that's what got me
hero.description: Live highlighter on Reddit, then Twin detox. Film a backup before you demo to friends or judges.

media.title: What you should see
media.description: Placeholder visual until the real Twin recording ships. Labels on the feed, then Detoxed with a Feed pause best-effort banner.

steps.title: Scripted path + Demo Lock
steps.description: Only supported live path for v0. Fail any smoke check → play the backup recording.

items.title: Load unpacked
items.description: Same Chrome profile, logged into Reddit. Extension loaded after MV3 build.

items.title: Home: infinite + badge
items.description: Open reddit.com home. Confirm infinite scroll and inbox badge labels.

items.title: Toggle Detoxed
items.description: Badge hidden. Feed pause best-effort banner. Narrate if scroll still loads.

items.title: Pinned post + ask
items.description: Open the pinned video/post URL for autoplay and related labels. Ask: which mode at 1am? Film backup of this whole path before any public show.

items.question: Selectors broke this morning — what now?
items.answer: Do not wing it live. Use the backup recording and re-pin selectors before the next show.

items.question: Is the Chrome extension on this site yet?
items.answer: Not yet. This page documents the path; the MV3 package ships in a later feature.
